title: Risk Communication Management Policy
definition: Maintain a Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) or similar cybersecurity business intelligence software platform to document, track, and report on the organization's cybersecurity risks.

title: Risk Communication Management Policy
definition: Ensure the GRC or similar cybersecurity business intelligence software platform maps the organization's cybersecurity tools against approved and prioritized cybersecurity safeguards.

title: Risk Communication Management Policy
definition: Ensure the GRC or similar cybersecurity business intelligence software platform automatically integrates with all appropriate cybersecurity technologies to aggregate data regarding potential cybersecurity risks.

title: Risk Communication Management Policy
definition: Ensure the GRC or similar cybersecurity business intelligence software platform manually records the status of cybersecurity safeguards that cannot be automatically entered into the system.

title: Risk Communication Management Policy
definition: Ensure the GRC or similar cybersecurity business intelligence software platform defines quality thresholds for each aggregated, quantified data point.

title: Risk Communication Management Policy
definition: Ensure the GRC or similar cybersecurity business intelligence software platform uses dashboards that report cybersecurity risk on a safeguard basis.

title: Risk Communication Management Policy
definition: Ensure the GRC or similar cybersecurity business intelligence software platform uses dashboards that report cybersecurity risk per business unit.

title: Risk Communication Management Policy
definition: Ensure the GRC or similar cybersecurity business intelligence software platform uses dashboards that report cybersecurity risk both with and without approved exceptions taken into account.

title: Risk Communication Management Policy
definition: Ensure the GRC or similar cybersecurity business intelligence software platform regularly reports cybersecurity risk to executive leadership stakeholders.

title: Risk Communication Management Policy
definition: Ensure the GRC or similar cybersecurity business intelligence software platform regularly reports cybersecurity risk to business stakeholders.

title: Risk Communication Management Policy
definition: Ensure the GRC or similar cybersecurity business intelligence software platform regularly reports cybersecurity risk to technical stakeholders.
